start: A member joined to the gym, whose number the gym already knows, at the desk with an active plan

steps.action: Gym tab, My gym, tap 'Check in'
user_sees: Scanner page 'Scan the gym poster' with the live camera
must_not: A photo taken or saved
A picker for saved pictures

steps.action: Point the camera at the desk poster
user_sees: The check-in screen 'Gym check-in' with the gym's name as heading
'Tap Check in when you are at the gym.' and buttons 'Check in' and 'Not now'
must_not: The member checked in before tapping
Two check-in screens opened by one scan

user_sees: 'Checking you in at <gym>…'
'You're checked in at 6:42 pm'
'Start <today's routine>' and 'Done'
must_not: Two visits saved
A time in another time zone

user_sees: The workout opens in the check-in's place
must_not: Back showing a stale 'Start' screen

start: A joined member scans the poster with the phone's own camera app (link https://…/c/<CODE>)

user_sees: The app opens straight on 'Gym check-in' with 'Check in' and 'Not now'
must_not: The member checked in just by opening the link (a poster link forwarded to a WhatsApp group)

user_sees: The Gym tab
must_not: A visit saved

start: A joined member checking in for the first time; the app has no mobile number for them

steps.action: Scan the poster and tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'Type the mobile number your gym has for you. The app asks only once.'
Box 'Your mobile number' with '98290 12345' as the hint
must_not: The number asked for again on the next check-in

steps.action: Type the 10 digits and tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'You're checked in at <time>'
must_not: Spaces or +91 from autofill making the number wrong

start: A phone in no gym, or in another gym, scans this gym's poster

user_sees: 'Finding your gym…', then the gym's name as heading
Words saying the member is not in this gym (naming the other gym when there is one)
Buttons 'Join this gym' and 'Not now'
must_not: A check-in at a gym the member has not joined

steps.action: Tap 'Join this gym' and finish joining
user_sees: Back on the check-in, and the member is checked in
must_not: The member left in the old gym without a word

start: A joined member at the desk; several wrong cases

steps.action: Type a number that is too short and tap 'Check in'
user_sees: A plain error under the box; the number box stays
must_not: A call to the gym with a bad number

steps.action: Type a number not on the gym's list
user_sees: Words that the gym does not have this number, buttons 'Check in' and 'Change my number'
must_not: The member checked in anyway

steps.action: Scan a QR that is not a gym poster
user_sees: A line that this QR is not a gym poster; scanning goes on
must_not: A page opened for a random QR

steps.action: Check in with the internet off
user_sees: A plain error and 'Check in' to try again
must_not: 'You're checked in' shown for a visit that was not saved

start: A joined member who already checked in this morning; later a member whose plan has ended

steps.action: Scan the poster again and tap 'Check in'
user_sees: 'You were already checked in at <gym> today. Nothing more to do.'
must_not: A second visit for today

steps.action: A member with no plan covering today checks in
user_sees: Checked in, with 'Your gym membership is not active today. Please see the desk.'
must_not: The member turned away with no visit
The member shown as active

steps.action: A number the desk must approve first: tap 'Check in' before and after the desk says yes
user_sees: Before: a line to wait for the desk; after: 'You're checked in'
must_not: A check-in before the desk's yes

start: A member types their mobile number on the check-in screen

steps.action: Type the number and check in
user_sees: 'You're checked in at <time>'
must_not: The number sent to any gym other than the poster's gym
The camera picture kept

steps.action: Look at the desk's alerts in the admin app
user_sees: The gym's staff see the member waiting at the poster when the desk must approve
must_not: Another gym seeing the visit or the number
